capabilities: Reload installed plugins from the command palette
Reload plugins via a bound hotkey
Expose the reload command for ribbon binding via Commander
disambiguation: Reloads community plugins themselves, not notes, the vault, or the Obsidian app.
extras: Can also be installed through the BRAT beta plugin installer; the README includes build-from-source instructions.
motivation: The README cites concrete cases: forcing a plugin update, completing first initialization, and making new plugin configurations take effect, such as a Toggl Track issue fixed by manual reload.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reload a single plugin after it is installed or reconfigured, forcing users to restart the app or toggle plugins manually.

relations.evidence: or you can bind the command to ribbon via Commander
as a workaround before Toggl Track support manual reload button

summary: Utility that reloads installed Obsidian plugins on demand from the command palette or a hotkey so configuration or code changes take effect.
